*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

**Dream Combatant (Su):** At 5th level, an oneironaut is always aware when he is in a mindscape and can use his influence opportunity ability when in any mindscape, including a psychic duel. He can expend one use of influence opportunity to cast instigate psychic duelOA (DC 10 + 1/2 aethernaut level + oneironaut's Intelligence modifier), but only if he or his target are in the Dimension of Dreams, Nightmare, or on the Ethereal Plane.

This ability replaces the favored plane gained at 5th level.

**Dream Explorer (Su):** An oneironaut can use dream, mindscape doorOA, and nightmare in place of dimension door at 9th level, dream travelOA in place of ethereal jaunt at 12th level, and dream voyageOA in place of etherealness at 18th level. The save DC for any dream explorer ability that allows a saving throw is 10 + 1/2 aethernaut level + aethernaut's Intelligence modifier.

This alters rift step.
